note: USD per million tokens, keyed by revmux's actual_model. revmux runs `claude --print` under subscription (Max plan) auth, so nothing here is a real API bill; this is an API-list-price ESTIMATE for the cost block only. Where a model exposes separate input/output prices, usd = tokens/1e6 * output price (output-only, not blended), because revmux reports a single combined `tokens` figure per agent with no input/output split to weight a blend. Rates verified 2026-10-15 against the claude-api skill reference (shared/models.md, shared/model-migration.md). Haiku 5.5 has two rate cards; the entry is the <=100K-prompt card. The bare tier aliases (opus/sonnet/haiku) follow the current model of each tier. Re-check there when a model changes.
